prompt:
Create one clean pixel-art reference atlas for the existing NPC084 afraid/thinking eyes. Use the single attached 2x2 image as the exact portrait identity, emotion, palette, spacing, eye-opening shape, and blink-phase reference. Preserve this NPC's visible face and hair/head silhouette, warm muted skin, dark strongly outlined eyes, the source's actual tiny warm amber-brown iris color, and the existing fearful expression. Keep the same pixel scale and low-resolution sprite rendering.

Canvas: one seamless two-column by two-row sheet, without margin, gutters, labels, extra faces, text, or decoration. Preserve the reference canvas ratio 1024:560 and cell ratio 64:35. Cell order: top-left open eyes looking LEFT; top-right open eyes looking RIGHT; bottom-left half-blink eyes looking LEFT; bottom-right half-blink eyes looking RIGHT.

Preserve the exact source upper/lower eyelid contours, opening height and width, dark eye outline, and brow positions in all cells. The only left/right difference is a gentle one-native-pixel horizontal shift of each existing compact iris and pupil inside its current aperture. Preserve the iris size and its actual warm dark amber-brown hue from the reference; do not recolor toward blue/green. Half-blink cells retain the same gaze as the open cell above. Do not reveal more sclera or widen the opening; keep light sclera pixels muted warm beige and no broader than the source. Glints should be restrained and tiny, matching existing source flecks; never add white bands. Avoid larger eyes or irises, square/bar shapes, iris or pupil crossing a lid, disconnected/reshaped lids, brow or expression changes, face redesign, smoothing, antialiasing, blur, or any added content.
